description: The confirmed real-world failure, recovered end to end. A user's snapshot was line-wrapped by the medium they pasted it through, putting a literal newline exactly where a space belongs in each page title; JSON.parse rejected it and the user was told nothing. Here the same damage is repaired, the groups are restored, and the page stays open to say WHAT it fixed — a silent repair would leave a damaged backup looking healthy.
